name: Mecha cut reveal
looks: A hard cut lands on each unit, every one on its own full-bleed card carrying a colour-coded label chip that holds for a beat, with no crossfades between them. The sequence ends in a flash and a burst title that brings all the units together into one whole.
build: Swap one flat-shaded illustration per card on a stepped index with hard cuts only, reusing the HUD's mono label style for each chip and the wordmark-assemble slam for the closing burst title, set against a radial flash and speed lines.
sound: A hit on each cut, a riser through the last unit, and a big hit on the burst.
prompt: Cut hard from one labelled unit to the next, each getting its own full-bleed card and a short label chip, building toward a flash and a combined title that brings every unit together as one whole. Use it for anything made of distinct parts: the steps of a process, the members of a team, or the features that add up to a product.
source: an anime mecha-combine film in prompt-motion.com's gallery, studied 2026-10-07.
